# Classification review: lead (Claude) — owner set `lead`

**Scope.** The lead reviewed every open item whose `agent` is `lead` in `review/open-items.tsv`. The override rows are generated by
`tools/lead_overrides.py` into `review/overrides-lead.tsv`:
- per seal declaration, from the first coe-A error: the source line, column, message and the goal or expected type;
- per (file, provider), for the scan items.

The note of each row says what happened:
- `confirmed`: the tool's class and fix were right;
- `changed …`: the fix or class was corrected;
- `refined`: the fix now names the complete set of field or case readers;
- `resolved`: the tool had found no reader and the lead identified one;
- `needs a check`: a plausible fix that should be confirmed in the infoview during Stage 2;
- `kept tool reader`: the lead did not re-derive it.

## Corrections to the tool itself found during the review (applied to every owner set)

- **Reader index (attempt 4).** Field equations named `<field>_<def>` were missing from the index, for example
  `Complexity.NUPPT.coins_ofPolyTimeUniform`, `output_ofPolyTime` and `runAtL_ofPolyTime` (`PPT.lean`). Adding the suffix form found
  1,452 more published readers (`readers/`).
- **Harness interactions (DW10-W5).** Errors outside any declaration of the form "failed to set `[local irreducible]`" occur where
  the owner's own `attribute [local irreducible]` line meets the seal. They are not seal debt and get no class. SEAL-0306 and
  SEAL-0307 (no declaration) are now matched by path, line and named definition; checkpoint 1 had them as CHANGED/removed.
- **Statement test.** An error on the header's last line counted as a statement error even when it sits after the `:=`, for
  example the `rfl` of a one-line reader or the `by` of an unsolved proof. sub-B found this. Seal errors now carry their column, and
  only text before the top-level `:=` / `where` counts as the statement. STATEMENT went from 45 rows to 14. In the lead's set only
  IterateFindHost's `host_dispatch`, `host_branch` and `host_halt` remain, as DW-9 records.
- **Generated-equation matching.** References were compared after the equation-lemma suffix had been stripped, so two different
  references (`queryOf.match_1.eq_2` and `.splitter`) matched the same item and a NEW row was duplicated. They are now compared with
  only the private prefix removed, one-to-one.
- **open-items.tsv** now shows the tool's own class, with the reviewer and the reviewed class in two added columns, so a re-run does
  not feed overrides back into the reviews.

## Patterns (lead set)

- **Turing machine builders** (ModuleHost, IterateFindHost, PairSplit, UnaryMul):
  - Reads of `Turing.Action.apply` are field reads under `Cfg.ext`. Use the field equations: `apply_state`, `apply_output`,
    `apply_inputPos` and `apply_workTapePos` in Configuration.lean, `apply_workTapes` in Simulation.lean. The tool's pick,
    `apply_state` alone, did not cover them.
  - `unfold MultiTapeTM.step` is read by `step_of_some` (and `step_of_halt`), not `step_output`.
  - `change` goals on two steps read `runFrom`: use `runFrom_succ_eq_step` and `runFrom_zero`.
  - `Cfg.init` / `initCfg`: `initCfg_eq` plus the `init_*` field equations.
  - **`Turing.pairDecode`** (PairSplit `split_run`, UnaryMul `mul_run`, 12 scan items) is the one provider-reader set. Encoding.lean
    is outside the campaign and publishes only `pairDecode_nil`, while the steps compute other branches. The case equations to add
    there are listed in the inventory. They are STAGE2-PROVIDER-READER.
  - **`CodeTM.toFinTM`** (Universal `clockedAnswer_*`): only `toFinTM_k` is published, and the step reads the `tm`/`State` fields.
    The provider is Encoding.lean; this is STAGE2-PROVIDER-READER.
  - **`mul_back`** reads the `k`/`State` fields of the private `unaryMulTM` (`Fin 1` against `Fin unaryMulTM.k`). The fix is local
    (field equations, or a `MultiTapeTM 1 Bool MulControl` that the private def wraps). Marked "needs a check".
- **Ensembles and reductions:**
  - `distAdv` and `acceptProb` reads are mostly `abs_*` / `uprob_*` lemmas applied to the sealed body; use `distAdv_def` and
    `acceptProb_def`. In two places the tool named the wrong one of the pair; corrected.
  - Constructor field reads on `NUPPT.ofPolyTime` and `ofPolyTimeUniform` (`.coins`) now use the published `coins_ofPolyTime` and
    `coins_ofPolyTimeUniform`.
  - Stuck `Fintype ?m` / `Nonempty ?m` errors are the sample spaces of sealed `acceptProb`, `predProb` or `invProb`. Use their `_def`.
- **Collections:** `P.OneWay` passed where `Collection.OneWay` is expected; use `PermCollection.oneWay_iff` and
  `TrapdoorCollection.oneWay_iff`.
- **Readers proved by `rfl` in the definition's own file** (`PadQuad.family_inLen`): the whole-file seal makes the definition
  irreducible after it. The fix is to prove the reader through `unfold` / `eq_def`.
- **IterateFind (F-01, pending #347):** the read is the `State` field of the host machine (`.inl 0 : H.State`). `hostCtrl_eq` does
  not give it, and #347 records the fix.

## Not resolved by the lead

- C3-0004 (`polyTimeComputable_iterateFind.match_1.splitter`, Concrete) and the SamplingFinDist `probTrue.eq_1` read keep the tool's
  fix. sub-B proposes a reader for the same matcher, `polyTimeComputable_iterateFind_elim` in Repetition.lean, which would also
  serve C3-0004.
- The rows marked `needs a check`: the `glPad` / `glPad_hardCore` bridges (Functions), `exists_yaoReduction`, `statClose_sampleAll`,
  `computesFunInTime_unaryMul`, `exists_samplePrime_nuppt`, `mul_back` and the three `acceptProb_reparam*` / `acceptProb_pushRed`.

## Final delta (after all 1,487 seals)

The seals completed after the sub-agents' snapshot added 42 open rows, all in sub-A's or sub-B's sets: 25 SEAL-B-ONLY (Lamport,
SecureComputation/Defs and Compose) and 17 STRICT-ONLY (Randomness/Extraction/Rejection). The lead reviewed them
(`tools/delta_review.py` → `review/overrides-lead-delta.tsv`; three by hand, in `review/delta-manual.tsv`):
- **B-only rows.** Each first coe-B error reads PolyExpr.eval (Lamport: `Fin (PolyExpr.var.eval n)` against `Fin n`), or is a
  cascade from a definition of the same file that fails earlier under B (`otFunctionality`, `lamportOWF`).
- **Strict-only rows.** These are the FinDist coercion (`CoeFun.coe p a` against `p.prob a`).

The lead's first pass had confirmed C1-0284 and the Enumeration `Complexity.P` item; both are local `let P` bindings (DW10-W7)
and are no longer open (`review/unmatched-overrides.txt`).
